info.description: Shipments, returns (RMA), suppliers and purchase orders. Uses the access tokens issued by the backend.
info.title: Warehouse Service API

get.description: Lists products whose stock plus units outstanding on open purchase orders is at or below the threshold, with suggestedQuantity = 4 × threshold − stock − incoming. Sorted by projected stock, then product id.

parameters.description: Inclusive low-stock threshold; at least one
parameters.name: lowStockThreshold

get.description: Lists purchase orders newest first, optionally filtered by status. Negative page is clamped to zero; size is clamped to 1-100.

post.description: Creates a DRAFT purchase order. Lines may be empty until submission; each product may appear once.

400.description: Invalid purchase order or duplicate product

get.description: Returns one purchase order with received and outstanding quantities.

put.description: Replaces the supplier, note and lines of a DRAFT purchase order.

400.description: Invalid purchase order or duplicate product

404.description: Purchase order, supplier or product not found

409.description: Purchase order is no longer a draft

post.description: Cancels a DRAFT or SUBMITTED purchase order. Orders with received goods cannot be cancelled.

409.description: Purchase order cannot be cancelled in its status

post.description: Books received units for SUBMITTED or PARTIALLY_RECEIVED purchase orders and raises stock with PURCHASE_RECEIVED movements. Receiving more than is outstanding returns 409. Repeating requestId with the same lines returns the current purchase order without booking again.

400.description: Invalid receipt, duplicate product, or product not on the purchase order

409.description: Not open for receipt, over-receipt, or requestId reused with different lines

post.description: DRAFT to SUBMITTED. Requires at least one line; expectedAt is the submission time plus the supplier lead time.

409.description: Purchase order is not a draft

get.description: Lists returns oldest first, optionally filtered by status. Negative page is clamped to zero; size is clamped to 1-100.

post.description: REQUESTED to APPROVED. The customer is emailed.

409.description: Transition not allowed from the current return status

post.description: APPROVED to RECEIVED. Every returned product needs a condition; RESELLABLE units go back to stock as RETURN_RESTOCKED movements.

400.description: Conditions missing or not matching the returned products

409.description: Transition not allowed from the current return status

post.description: RECEIVED to REFUNDED. The refund is the returned items' value scaled by the order's total-to-subtotal ratio, rounded half-up. The customer is emailed.

409.description: Transition not allowed from the current return status

post.description: REQUESTED to REJECTED with a note for the customer. Rejected quantities become returnable again.

409.description: Transition not allowed from the current return status

post.description: Creates a supplier with a case-insensitively unique name and a lead time of 0-365 days.

get.description: Returns the shipment for one of the caller's orders. Administrators may track any order.

404.description: Order not found, or not released to the warehouse yet

get.description: Returns the carrier tracking (scans, current status, estimated delivery) for one of the caller's orders. Administrators may track any order. Before the hand-over to the carrier the events are empty.

404.description: Order not found, or not released to the warehouse yet

post.description: Opens a return for the caller's DELIVERED order within 30 days of delivery. Each product may appear once, and quantities cannot exceed what was bought minus units in other non-rejected returns.

400.description: Invalid request, duplicate product, or product not in the order

409.description: Order not delivered, return window passed, or quantity exceeds what can be returned

get.description: Lists the caller's returns newest first. Negative page is clamped to zero; size is clamped to 1-100.
Returns one of the caller's returns with its estimated or paid refund.

Public, no authentication. Returns the carrier, current status, estimated delivery and scans of the parcel; no order id, customer or address. Surrounding spaces are ignored and letters are upper-cased.
Lists PAID orders that have not been released to the warehouse yet, oldest first. Negative page is clamped to zero; size is clamped to 1-100.
Lists shipments oldest first, optionally filtered by status. Negative page is clamped to zero; size is clamped to 1-100.

post.description: Releases a PAID order to the warehouse as an AWAITING_PICK shipment.

409.description: Order is not PAID or already has a shipment

get.description: Returns one shipment with its timestamps.

post.description: Cancels an AWAITING_PICK or PICKED shipment. The order is cancelled, stock is restored and any coupon redemption is released.

409.description: Transition not allowed from the current shipment status

post.description: Fast-forwards a simulated SHIPPED shipment by one carrier scan (IN_TRANSIT, OUT_FOR_DELIVERY, DELIVERY_FAILED or DELIVERED) without waiting for the step interval. The DELIVERED step delivers the shipment like the deliver endpoint.

409.description: Not a simulated shipment in status SHIPPED

post.description: SHIPPED to DELIVERED. The order becomes DELIVERED, which enables reviews and returns, and the customer receives an email.

409.description: Transition not allowed from the current shipment status

post.description: PICKED to PACKED with the package weight (0.01-30.00 kg).

409.description: Transition not allowed from the current shipment status
Transition not allowed from the current shipment status

get.description: Returns the products to pick grouped by product and sorted by category, then name.

post.description: PACKED to SHIPPED. The tracking number must match the carrier format. Without a tracking number the parcel goes to the simulated carrier, which generates a tracking number and moves the parcel through IN_TRANSIT and OUT_FOR_DELIVERY to DELIVERED on its own. The order becomes SHIPPED and the customer receives an email.

400.description: Missing carrier or invalid tracking number

409.description: Transition not allowed from the current shipment status
